purpose: Repeat the most informative Solar-valid hybrid raw-lensing transfers with eight geometry starts and no gravity refit.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the follow-up bridge fit.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
The same four raw systems and within-family held-out images are used.
This checks numerical robustness; it does not remove the spherical-baryon, density-interpolation, or zero-slip approximations.
